source_acquisition.search_note: 自动 source inventory 为 no_public_source_found，且 corpus/visual_sources/icml-2026-536d8d3e0efc/ 为空。按 PDF/OpenReview 身份和完整标题执行 unicli/gh 检索，唯一直接命中仓库为 Jasonyzzhang/Provably_Convergent_Actor_Critic_Risk-averse_MARL；gh description 与论文标题直接对应，main 最新提交为 00cc143ec6a6。递归 tree 仅有两个 baseline PDF，无 plot*、figure*、visual*、table*、.ipynb、.tex、.tikz、.pgf、.svg、style 或 source-data 文件。因此只登记两个可核对的 rendered asset，Figures 1–4、6、8–11 和 Tables 1–5 无公开可编辑视觉源。

paper_style.palette_strategy: 概念图使用橙色/浅色块表达 player-adversary 关系和理论相区；Figure 3–5、7 使用 categorical run colors；Figure 6、9、11 固定以橙色 Risk-Averse 与紫色 Risk-Neutral 区分条件；Figure 8/10 使用环境角色色。除少数虚线/实线外，颜色是主要系列编码。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: 论文 Figure 1–9、11 与全部 Table 由 PDF 矢量文字、路径和填充组成；Figure 10 是唯一嵌入 raster RGB image（1155 × 1155，约 439 ppi）。公开仓库的两个 baseline PDF 是独立 rendered asset，不是论文的可编辑源。
paper_style.style_consistency: 正文/caption/Table 稳定使用 Nimbus Roman 与 Computer Modern math，图内 quantitative panels 稳定使用 DejaVu Sans 和浅灰 grid，但概念图、theory phase map、run-color panels 的色板分成局部系统。Table 1 的 ± 统计和 Figure 9/11 的 shaded envelope 缺少统一 caption 合同，Figure 7 没有可见 legend。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1. Illustration of the 4-player game structure.

color.semantic_mapping: Orange stroke/arrows and pale peach node fill mark the lifted player/adversary game; black labels carry the relation names.

encodings.color: orange relation emphasis versus black labels
encodings.text: Player, Adv, R_i, and D_i labels

figures.data_and_statistics: Conceptual interface diagram; no sample, numerical estimate, denominator, or uncertainty is encoded.
figures.evidence_relation: RQE minimax Eqs. (3)–(6) → Proposition 2.2 maps the original two-player game to a 4-player game → Figure 1 exposes player/adversary zero-sum and regularized links → Definition 2.3 and Theorem 3.1 supply the monotonicity consequence.
design_strengths: The four nodes and edge labels turn an abstract lifting construction into a single readable interface.
Symmetric placement makes the two player/adversary pairs easy to compare.
design_weaknesses: The caption does not define D_i, arrow direction, or why the lifted equilibrium recovers RQE.
Orange is decorative/semantic emphasis rather than a redundant data encoding.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a symmetric node-edge diagram to expose optimization roles, and label every edge with the operator or coupling it represents.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2. RQE uniqueness region for KL/log-barrier or reverse KL/negative entropy. Green captures the region indicated by Theorems 3.1 and 3.2. Orange captures that in Zhang & Mazumdar (2025) and blue captures that in Mazumdar et al. (2025).

color.semantic_mapping: Green, orange, and blue fills/boundaries identify the uniqueness conditions from this work, Zhang & Mazumdar (2025), and Mazumdar et al. (2025).

figures.data_and_statistics: Theoretical parameter regions, not sampled observations. Boundaries represent ϵ_1ϵ_2τ_1τ_2 > 1/16, ϵ_1τ_2 > 1/4 with ϵ_2τ_1 > 1/4, and ϵ_1ϵ_2τ_1τ_2 > 1; no repeat, error, denominator, or failure value is present.
figures.evidence_relation: Theorem 3.1–3.2 monotonicity/uniqueness conditions → Figure 2 compares new and prior sufficient regions on one parameter plane → §4 uses the regularity to motivate Bellman contraction and Markov-game extension.
design_strengths: One coordinate system makes the relative breadth of the three sufficient conditions immediately comparable.
The legend names the provenance of each colored region.
design_weaknesses: Region identity depends heavily on color and dashed boundaries; grayscale separation is weak.
Axis-variable meanings and the fact that boundaries are sufficient theory conditions are not fully repeated in the caption.
figures.reusable_pattern: Plot competing theoretical regimes on one shared parameter plane with fills plus boundary curves, and state each condition in the caption.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3. GD dynamics for different τ with KL and log-barrier risks, ϵ_i = 0.2 and τ_1 = τ_2.

color.semantic_mapping: Four colors identify τ=0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0; gray curves identify the two risk-neutral settings.

encodings.y: Probability of action 0 for Player 1 or Player 2
encodings.line: solid τ curves; dashed/dash-dot risk-neutral curves

figures.data_and_statistics: Projected gradient trajectories for one Inspection Game with ϵ_i=0.2 and τ_1=τ_2; this is a single deterministic illustration with no repeated-run statistic, denominator, interval, or test.
figures.evidence_relation: Inspection Game payoff matrices and projected update → Figure 3 connects τ to policy probability trajectories and the RQE fixed point → text interprets risk-neutral non-convergence and faster convergence at larger τ → later Gridworld/Simple Tag training curves test the broader stability claim.
design_strengths: A small interpretable game makes the proposed risk-aversion mechanism visually concrete.
The two panels share the τ legend and show both players under identical settings.
design_weaknesses: The caption omits the colors/line styles and does not state the non-convergence/faster-convergence finding.
A single trajectory illustration cannot establish multi-agent training stability or statistical uncertainty.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a controlled toy game first to show how a mechanism changes trajectories before presenting larger training comparisons.

evidence.label: Figure 3: GD dynamics for different τ

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4. MA100 reward curves of gridworld cooperation game for 10 risk-averse and 10 risk-neutral training runs.

color.semantic_mapping: Each categorical color identifies one of Run 0–9; panel title identifies RA/RN condition and agent.

plot_grammar.legend_placement: lower right of Risk-Averse Agent 0 panel

figures.data_and_statistics: Ten independent RA and ten independent RN Gridworld training runs, shown as 100-episode moving-average reward curves. The figure has no confidence interval, seed listing, formal test, or failure-value summary.
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 3 mechanism → Figure 4 compares risk-averse and risk-neutral training runs → Figure 5 adds MAPPO/MADDPG baselines → Table 1 summarizes a separate Simple Tag final reward comparison.
design_strengths: All runs remain visible instead of hiding heterogeneity behind one mean line.
The 2 × 2 layout keeps agent and risk condition comparisons aligned.
design_weaknesses: Run identity relies on ten colors and is not grayscale-safe.
The comparator changes adversary/loss structure, so the curves are not an isolated component ablation.
figures.reusable_pattern: Keep repeated runs as small multiples or overlaid traces on a fixed panel contract, and state the moving-average window and run denominator.

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5. MA100 reward curves of gridworld cooperation game of MAPPO and MADDPG for 5 independent training runs.

color.semantic_mapping: Each color identifies one of five MAPPO/MADDPG baseline runs; panel title identifies algorithm and agent.

plot_grammar.legend_placement: upper right of MAPPO Agent 0 panel

figures.data_and_statistics: Five independent runs each for MAPPO and MADDPG in the Gridworld; lines are MA100 rewards with different y ranges by agent/algorithm. No interval, seed, test, or failure count is reported.
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 4 RA/RN comparison → Figure 5 external baseline curves → text uses their instability as a qualitative comparator for the risk-averse actor-critic. The public rendered baseline PDF matches this panel family but does not expose source parameters.
design_strengths: The same 2 × 2 panel grammar makes both baseline algorithms directly comparable.
The independent-run traces make baseline instability visible rather than only reporting a final point.
design_weaknesses: Five run colors are not redundant with shape or line style.
No matched hyperparameter or final-statistic control is visible, so instability is descriptive rather than causal evidence.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a fixed algorithm × agent panel matrix for baseline comparison, but retain a legend and a common aggregation/statistical contract.

figures.label: Figure 6

caption.text: Figure 6. MA100 reward curves of Simple Tag fixing good agents for 5 risk-averse and 5 risk-neutral training runs.

color.semantic_mapping: Five categorical colors identify runs; panel title identifies risk condition.

encodings.color: run identity; panel title encodes RA/RN

figures.data_and_statistics: Five independent RA and five independent RN training runs for fixed-good-agent MPE Simple Tag; plotted quantity is MA100 adversary reward. No interval, seed, denominator beyond run count, or formal test is shown.
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 10 defines the MPE roles → fixed good-agent policy creates the cooperative adversary task → Figure 6 compares RA/RN curves → Figure 7 gives MAPPO/MADDPG baselines → Table 1 reports final reward.
design_strengths: The two-panel condition comparison is compact and preserves all five runs.
The fixed-good-agent setting is named in the caption, making the task transformation visible.
design_weaknesses: The caption does not explain how the good policy was fixed or define run colors.
Fixed-good-agent cooperative training is narrower than joint 3-agent general-sum learning.
figures.reusable_pattern: When a task is transformed before training, place the transformation next to the condition panels and keep run counts explicit.

evidence.label: Figure 6: Simple Tag RA/RN run curves

figures.label: Figure 7

caption.text: Figure 7. MA100 reward curves of Simple Tag fixing good agents of MAPPO and MADDPG for 5 independent training runs.

color.semantic_mapping: Five run colors appear in each MAPPO/MADDPG panel; no visible legend maps colors to run IDs.

encodings.text: panel titles only; no run labels

figures.data_and_statistics: Five independent MAPPO and five independent MADDPG runs for fixed-good-agent Simple Tag, displayed as MA100 reward curves. No uncertainty interval, seed, final summary, or test is given.
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 6 RA/RN curves → Figure 7 baseline curves → Table 1 final reward summary. The public `simple_tag_fixed_good_baselines.pdf` matches the two-panel rendered baseline asset, but no editable plotting source is public.
design_strengths: The baseline task and episode range match Figure 6, enabling a direct qualitative contrast.
The two panels avoid overloading the main page with additional rows.
design_weaknesses: There is no visible legend or direct run label, so the five colored traces cannot be identified reliably.
The caption does not state a main finding and the baseline comparison remains descriptive.
figures.reusable_pattern: Never rely on a neighboring figure’s implicit legend; repeat a compact legend or use direct labels for every run-level panel.

figures.label: Figure 8

caption.text: Figure 8. Gridworld Layout. Agent 0 and agent 1 are shown in blue and red dots on the upper-left corner. The defection zones are painted in blue (for agent 0) and red (for agent 1)

color.semantic_mapping: Cell fills identify blue/red defection zones and gray cooperation zone; blue/red dots identify agent starts.

encodings.text: Agent 0/1 marker numerals and layout title

figures.data_and_statistics: Static 5 × 5 environment layout; 25 cells plus two agent markers and three special zones. No observations, denominator, repeat, or uncertainty is encoded.

design_strengths: The grid makes start state and special cells immediately locatable.
Marker size and cell position provide some redundancy beyond color.
design_weaknesses: The caption omits the gray cooperation zone and blank area.
Blue/red role semantics remain color-dependent in grayscale.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a compact grid map for state-space roles, and enumerate every special-cell color in the caption.

figures.label: Figure 9

caption.text: Figure 9. Detailed gridworld cooperation game comparison across 10 independent training runs.

color.semantic_mapping: Orange and purple identify risk-averse and risk-neutral traces; translucent fills surround training traces.

plot_grammar.legend_placement: repeated in each panel (upper/right or lower/right)

encodings.x: Episode 0–20000 for training; Evaluation Episode 0–40 for evaluation/social welfare
encodings.y: MA100 Training Reward, Evaluation Reward, or Social Welfare (Sum of Agents)
encodings.line: solid/dashed lines; dashed separates agents in evaluation panels

figures.data_and_statistics: Ten independent Gridworld runs, each with two MA100 training panels, one 40-episode evaluation panel, and one social-welfare panel. Translucent envelopes show raw reward spread visually; the caption does not define them as SD, SE, or CI. No seed-level inferential test or failure count is provided.
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 8 layout/Table 3 settings → Figure 4 compressed RA/RN comparison → Figure 9 expands all ten repetitions, preserving training, evaluation, and social welfare → bounds the stability claim with visible run heterogeneity.
design_strengths: The fixed 4-column contract lets readers compare the same diagnostic across all ten repetitions.
Evaluation panels add solid/dashed agent identity while raw runs expose failures hidden by averages.
design_weaknesses: Forty panels, repeated legends, and approximately 4.7 pt text make the object dense.
Band semantics are undefined, and most condition/run identities depend on color.
figures.reusable_pattern: Reserve a dense appendix small-multiple grid for complete run-level evidence, but define envelope semantics and preserve a stable column contract.

evidence.label: Figure 9: Gridworld detailed repetitions; continuation and caption on p. 22

figures.label: Figure 10

caption.text: Figure 10. Layout of MPE2 Simple Tag environment with 3 agents. Green circle indicates the good agent, red circles indicate the adversaries, and black circles indicate the obstacles.

color.semantic_mapping: Green marks the good agent, red marks adversaries, and black marks obstacles in the embedded raster layout.

encodings.shape: small agent circles versus large obstacle circles

figures.data_and_statistics: Static MPE2 Simple Tag scene with one good-agent circle, two adversary circles, and two obstacle circles. It contains no axes, trajectory, sample, denominator, or uncertainty.
figures.evidence_relation: §5.3 and Appendix D.2 define fixed-good-agent Simple Tag → Figure 10 shows the three roles and obstacles → Tables 4–5 specify the two training stages → Figures 6/7/11 provide reward evidence.
design_strengths: The scene communicates the predator-prey roles with very few marks.
Obstacle size distinguishes obstacles from agents even when color is unavailable.
design_weaknesses: There are no coordinates, boundary, collision, or leaving-area annotations.
Good/adversary role still relies on color, and the raster has no text labels.
figures.reusable_pattern: For a spatial environment sketch, use size plus color for role classes and place the dynamic rules in adjacent prose or a caption.

figures.label: Figure 11

caption.text: Figure 11. Detailed MPE Simple Tag comparison across 5 independent training runs.

color.semantic_mapping: Orange and purple identify Risk-Averse and Risk-Neutral; translucent fills are raw-reward spread around each line.

plot_grammar.legend_placement: upper left of first repetition panel

encodings.y: Rep n Reward; linear scale with per-panel y limits

figures.data_and_statistics: Five independent fixed-good-agent Simple Tag runs, showing adversary 0 MA100 reward and translucent raw-reward envelopes. No SD/SE/CI definition, seed, final summary, or formal comparison is present; y ranges differ across repetitions.
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 10 and Tables 4–5 define the environment/stages → Figure 6 gives the main compressed RA/RN curves → Figure 11 restores each run → checks the “more consistent, similar final performance” wording.
design_strengths: Five stacked panels preserve per-run heterogeneity while keeping the x-axis common.
A single shared legend prevents repeated furniture across the page.
design_weaknesses: Different y-axis limits make vertical cross-row comparisons unsafe.
The envelope has no stated statistical definition and condition identity is color-only.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use stacked per-run panels to reveal heterogeneity, but retain common y limits where cross-run magnitude matters and define the shaded quantity.

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1. Performance comparison of different algorithms.

tables.uncertainty: Mean ± standard deviation across 5 runs; no confidence interval, p-value, effect size, or test is shown.
tables.data_and_statistics: One-row final reward summary: Risk-averse AC 36.74±2.65, MAPPO 35.50±4.91, MADDPG 30.20±9.53. The table does not state units or the Simple Tag setting.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 6/7 trajectories → Table 1 final-reward cells → conclusion claim of higher reward and lower variance. It is not a matched component ablation because the risk-neutral comparator changes the game/loss structure.
design_strengths: A single metric row and uniform two-decimal precision make the headline comparison quick to scan.
Booktabs rules avoid visual clutter in the narrow right column.
design_weaknesses: Caption omits environment, run denominator, and the meaning of ±.
No highlighting distinguishes best/second-best and no uncertainty/test context accompanies the values.
tables.reusable_pattern: Put the headline metric in one aligned row with explicit aggregation and uncertainty definitions in the caption.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 将 RQE 的 4-player lifting 具体化，Figure 2 对齐 theorem uniqueness regions，Figure 3 以 Inspection Game 展示 τ 的行为机制，Figures 4–7 提供 Gridworld/Simple Tag 的主文 training comparison，Table 1 收束 final reward；Appendix Figures 8–11 与 Tables 2–5 提供环境、超参和逐-run复现。
cross_object_system.caption_system: caption 统一为 italic Figure/Table n. 加短标题；Figure 2 与 Figure 3 有最完整的颜色/设置信息，其他 caption 多只命名任务和 run 数。没有粗体结论标题，Figure 9/11 的 translucent band、Table 1 的 ± 定义和多数 panel legend 没有在 caption 中独立说明。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1 使用 algorithm-as-column、Reward-as-row；Table 2 使用 Notation/Description；Tables 3–5 统一 Category/Hyperparameter/Value 并以 Common/Risk-Aversion/Environment 分组。booktabs 和衬线字体一致，但 Table 4/5 caption 相同，阶段识别依赖正文和值列。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1/2 承担方法与理论接口，Figure 3 是 τ sensitivity mechanism，Figures 4/6 对比 RA/RN，Figures 5/7 对比 MAPPO/MADDPG，Table 1 给 Simple Tag final summary，Figures 9/11 暴露 run heterogeneity。没有 isolated component-deletion ablation；risk-neutral comparator 同时改变 adversary/loss，因此曲线不构成单组件因果证据。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 主文 p. 8–9 调用 Appendix C 的 Algorithm 2 与 Appendix D.1/D.2；Figure 8/10 和 Tables 3–5 将环境/训练条件实体化，Figure 9/11 把主文 compressed curves 展开到每个 run。Appendices E–I 是 proof-only，没有额外 Figure/Table。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: caption/Table 的 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern math 一致，图内 DejaVu Sans 形成独立 chart subsystem；Figure 9 的最小字号约 4.7 pt，低于其他图和表。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Figures 6、9、11 复用橙/紫 RA/RN 语义；Figures 4、5、7 的 categorical run colors 仅在各图内稳定。Figure 8/10 的环境色不与结果色冲突，但 run identity 和条件比较总体缺少灰度冗余。

most_reusable_patterns: 用 Figure 1 的对称 player/adversary graph 和 Figure 2 的同轴 theorem-region map，把抽象机制变成可扫描的视觉接口。
先用 Figure 3 的 toy dynamics 固定 τ 的行为解释，再以 2 × 2/2-panel MA100 small multiples 承接多环境 run comparison。
主文保留压缩 comparison/Table 1，附录用 Figure 9/11 的同构 small multiples 保留 run heterogeneity；环境 layout 和 hyperparameter row groups 紧邻详细曲线。
highest_value_objects: Figure 2：理论 uniqueness 条件与前作的同轴相区比较。
Figure 3：τ、risk-neutral non-convergence 与 RQE policy behavior 的机制桥。
Figure 4、Figure 5 与 Table 1：RA/RN run curves、外部 baseline trajectories 和 final reward summary 组成主要实证链。
Figures 9/11：附录中最适合审计稳定性和异质性的逐-run对象；Figure 1 是方法接口的核心概念图。
failure_patterns: caption 普遍短，未独立定义全部编码、分母和不确定性；Figure 8 caption 漏掉灰色 cooperation zone，Table 4/5 caption 完全相同。
Figure 9/11 的 translucent envelope 没有说明是 raw spread、SD、SE 还是 CI；主文没有正式区间或检验。
多数组件依赖颜色，Figure 7 没有可见 legend；Figure 9 的 40 panels 和约 4.7 pt 小字增加阅读成本。
公开仓库只有两个 rendered baseline PDF，没有 plot script、TeX、数据或完整复现源。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文按「四玩家机制图 → theorem 参数相区 → τ 行为轨迹 → 多环境 run curves 与 final-reward 表 → 附录逐-run复现」推进证据，采用 booktabs 和 Matplotlib small multiples，但 caption 解释、统计不确定性和灰度冗余偏弱。
